shots.text: With all six Wardens awake, their oath held Vael-Orrun again, and the gap in the Gate could get no wider. Only the whole Heartstone could break the oath now.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A map of the Ring: six lands lit again, the Rift in the east, the Heartstone glowing at Solenne in the centre.

shots.text: So everything he had left came out of the Rift at once and marched west for Solenne, with Cassivane at its head. We raced it home.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A grey tide pouring out of the Rift and across the plains toward the centre of the map; the Concord's army on a parallel road, ahead of it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Six vast figures walking across the plains toward the city, each glowing its own colour: Ignar, Aurath, Elowen, Thalassa, Orrok, Nyxara. Refugees stop to watch them pass.

shots.text:
Queen of Solenne. When this is over, I will tell you what we did at Vael.

Not before.
shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Thalassa bending low to the blind Queen at Solenne's gate; the other Wardens look away.

shots.text: Cassivane's army was camped at Crossmere, the town where every road on the Ring meets, a day east of Solenne. We had to go through him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Crossmere, a crossroads town at night, ringed by a grey war camp. Cassivane's standard: a red field, now burned black.
